notes.text: Bowen Byram is day to day (upper-body injury) and has missed the last 7 games. He is a top-pair defenseman. Wyatt Kaiser has taken his spot beside Artyom Levshunov. That pair has had 34% of the chances at 5-on-5 in 80:55 together, down from 47% with Byram.
Aleksander Barkov is on long-term injured reserve (lower-body injury) and has missed the last 12 games. He is one of their best players.
Brad Marchand is on injured reserve (leg injury) and has missed the last 10 games. He is a top-six forward.
Cooper Black was added to the roster on Oct 21.
Cole Reinhardt was added to the roster on Oct 23 and has played beside Eetu Luostarinen and Anton Lundell.

FLA.head: This one sets up well for the Panthers
FLA.body: Even though Florida will be without Barkov, the Panthers have been out-chancing opponents by a wide margin lately and have home-ice advantage. The Blackhawks’ best way in is keeping dangerous shots away.

CHI.head: The Panthers should be favored
CHI.body: Even though Florida will be without Barkov, the Panthers have been out-chancing opponents by a wide margin lately and have home-ice advantage. To pull this off, the Blackhawks can start with keeping dangerous shots away, plus Spencer Knight stealing the show.

story.head: Who drives the play: the Panthers
paras: The Panthers won the teams’ first meeting this season, 3-2 in Chicago on Oct 25. The Panthers have won three straight, while the Blackhawks (4-9-1) lost 5-4 in overtime to Boston on Saturday. Going in, the Hawks are last in the Central (31st in the NHL) and the Panthers fifth in the Atlantic (tied for eighth).

The Blackhawks have played better than their record (.321) says: their chances are worth about .384, and their finishing has held them back. The Panthers’ record (.643) is about what their chances are worth.

The Blackhawks pick their shots (2nd lowest), don't block many shots (32nd) and have struggled on the power play (31st). Chicago has scored 2.21 goals a game, the second fewest in the league, and allowed 3.79, the third most. The Panthers forecheck harder than anyone (1st) and rarely ice the puck (1st). They also are the league’s most physical team (1st), so the Panthers hit a lot, but the Blackhawks mostly don’t. The Panthers are likely to get plenty of pucks to the net against the Blackhawks.

Connor Bedard (4 G / 5 A / 9 P in 8 GP) leads the Blackhawks in scoring, and Roman Kantserov (5 G / 2 A / 7 P in 14 GP) has a team-high five goals. For the Panthers, Matthew Tkachuk (4 G / 16 A / 20 P in 14 GP) leads the way in scoring, and Brady Tkachuk (8 G / 7 A / 15 P in 14 GP) has a team-high eight goals.
Spencer Knight (4-7-0 / .897 SV% in 11 GS) will likely start for Chicago, and Akira Schmid (5-2-1 / .888 SV% in 7 GS) for Florida.
The Panthers usually control more of the chances than the Blackhawks do.

items.text: The Panthers have been without Jacob Markström, Aleksander Barkov and Brad Marchand for several games. Akira Schmid is expected to start.
The Blackhawks have been without Bowen Byram since Oct 13.
Sam Reinhart has five goals in seven games against Chicago since 2023-24.
Carter Verhaeghe has eight goals on chances worth about 4.5 goals, well above what his finishing usually turns chances into. Runs like that tend to cool off.
